EnergyOurServices1.description: From exploration to distribution, we provide end-to-end solutions across the oil & gas value chain.

services.title: Exploration & Drilling
services.imageAlt: Exploration and drilling offshore oil rig platform at sunset
services.description1: We provide comprehensive oil & gas engineering services designed to meet the evolving needs of the energy industry. Our solutions combine advanced technology, industry expertise and best practices to deliver safe, efficient and cost-effective outcomes across the entire project lifecycle.
services.description2: Our oil & gas engineering services cover a wide range of solutions tailored to your operational goals.

services.heading3: Why Choose Our Oil & Gas Engineering Services
services.description3: We bring together industry expertise, innovation and a commitment to safety and sustainability to deliver engineering solutions you can trust.

services.title: Production & Processing
services.imageAlt: Oil and gas refinery distillation towers and processing plant
services.description1: We provide end-to-end production and processing facilities engineering designed to meet demanding oil & gas standards. Our solutions combine cutting-edge refining technology, field expertise and automation to deliver maximized throughput safely.
services.description2: Our production & processing operations deliver high performance refining and chemical treatment systems.
services.imageOfferAlt: Modern processing distillation towers and plant units
services.heading3: Why Choose Our Production & Processing Services
services.description3: We optimize operational yields while reducing carbon intensity and preventing unplanned downtime across refineries.

whyChoosePoints.text: Decades of proven petrochemical and refinery track record
High recovery efficiency and reduced flaring

services.imageWhyChooseAlt: Industrial pipeline transport connecting processing unit

services.title: Pipeline & Transportation
services.imageAlt: Oil and gas pipeline transportation network at sunset
services.description1: We engineer and maintain safe, high-capacity pipeline infrastructures for hydrocarbon transmission. From cross-country trunklines to gathering networks, we ensure leak-free, regulated transmission across challenging environments.
services.description2: Our pipeline transportation services cover engineering, installation, hydro-testing, and life-cycle integrity assurance.
services.imageOfferAlt: Oil and gas transmission pipeline grid
services.heading3: Why Choose Our Pipeline & Logistics Services
services.description3: Our midstream engineering guarantees continuous flow, zero-loss compliance, and environmental safety.

whyChoosePoints.text: Rapid emergency response and hot tapping capabilities
Compliance with ASME B31.4 / B31.8 international codes

services.imageWhyChooseAlt: Large scale bulk terminal storage connected with pipeline

services.title: Storage & Terminal Solutions
services.imageAlt: Industrial oil and fuel storage tanks and terminal facilities
services.description1: We design, build, and automate high-capacity storage terminals for crude oil, refined products, and petrochemicals. Our facilities integrate floating roof tanks, automated custody transfer, and world-class vapor recovery systems.
services.description2: Our terminal solutions support rail, marine jetty, and truck loading operations with precise blending capabilities.

offerPoints.text: Automated Truck Loading Racks & Flow Metering

services.imageOfferAlt: Petroleum product storage farm with spherical and cylindrical tanks
services.heading3: Why Choose Our Storage & Terminal Facilities
services.description3: We empower supply chain resilience with safe, compliant, and highly automated bulk storage operations.

whyChoosePoints.text: Turnkey EPC execution with proven tank farm delivery
Strict adherence to NFPA, API, and environmental standards

services.imageWhyChooseAlt: Offshore and coastal storage delivery network

EnergySustainability1.introDescription: At ENERGYPRO, we believe that operational excellence goes hand in hand with the health, safety, environment and well-being of our people, communities and the planet. We are committed to conducting our operations responsibly while minimizing environmental impact and creating long-term value.
EnergySustainability1.safetyDescription: We are dedicated to providing a safe and healthy workplace for all employees, contractors and visitors. Our health and safety policy ensures risk-free operations through robust systems, preventive measures and continuous improvement.
EnergySustainability1.safetyImageAlt: Engineers in protective safety gear at industrial plant
EnergySustainability1.envDescription: We take proactive steps to minimize our environmental footprint through responsible operations, pollution prevention and efficient resource utilization.
EnergySustainability1.envImageAlt: Worker holding sapling in soil in front of plant
EnergySustainability1.practicesDescription: We implement industry best practices to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations across all our projects.
EnergySustainability1.practicesImageAlt: Engineer checking digital tablet at refinery facility
EnergySustainability1.cleanerDescription: We are focused on sustainable growth through innovative solutions, energy efficiency and responsible operations.

cleanerChecklist.text: Support for renewable energy and low-carbon solutions

EnergySustainability1.cleanerImageAlt: Lush green grass in front of modern clean energy distillation facility
EnergySustainability1.standardsDescription: We comply with all applicable laws, industry standards and regulatory requirements. Our internal procedures ensure consistent monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement.
EnergySustainability1.cultureDescription: We conduct regular training programs, safety workshops and awareness initiatives to ensure that our team is well-equipped with the knowledge and skills to maintain safe and responsible operations.
EnergySustainability1.cultureImageAlt: Safety first training session with industrial workers and whiteboard
EnergySustainability1.commitmentDescription: We remain committed to continuous improvement in health, safety, environmental performance and sustainability, ensuring a safer workplace, a cleaner environment and stronger communities.
EnergySustainability1.commitmentImageAlt: Hands holding green globe with sustainability icons

EnergyProjects1.subtitle: OUR PROJECTS
EnergyProjects1.title: EXPLORE OUR
EnergyProjects1.description: Delivering high-impact engineering, pipeline logistics, offshore drilling, and bulk terminal installations across global energy corridors.

items.title: Deepwater Offshore Platform Development
items.description: EPC execution of high-depth drilling infrastructure featuring harsh-weather stability systems and zero-discharge environmental compliance.
items.imageAlt: Deepwater offshore drilling platform at sunset

items.title: Petrochemical Fractionation & Refining Complex
items.description: Turnaround engineering and modernization of crude distillation units, raising daily throughput by 35% with state-of-the-art energy recovery.
items.imageAlt: Petrochemical distillation columns and processing facility

items.title: Cross-Country High-Pressure Gas Trunkline
items.description: Over 480km of automated 42-inch high-pressure pipeline equipped with fiber-optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) for leak detection.

items.title: Strategic Coastal Liquid Terminal Expansion
items.description: Erection of 8 new API 650 floating-roof storage tanks with automated radar gauging, marine jetty tanker arms, and vapor combustion.
items.imageAlt: Strategic bulk terminal and crude storage tanks

items.title: Subsea Wellhead Tie-Back & Flowline Integration
items.description: Integrated subsea manifold installation and umbilical connections engineered for ultra-high temperature and corrosive reservoir environments.
items.imageAlt: Subsea and offshore marine drilling operations

items.title: Clean Fuels Hydrotreater Modernization
items.description: Hydroprocessing and sulfur recovery unit engineering delivering ultra-low sulfur diesel (ULSD) meeting stringent Euro VI specifications.

items.title: Multi-Product Jet Fuel & Diesel Pipeline
items.description: Dual-line batching pipeline network linking regional refineries directly to airport fuel depots with automated SCADA custody transfer.
items.imageAlt: Industrial pipeline transport connecting to airport distribution

items.title: Automated High-Speed Terminal Loading Racks
items.description: 16-bay bottom-loading automated truck terminal capable of handling over 250 road tankers daily with vapor recovery safety integration.
items.imageAlt: Automated bulk storage and distribution rack facility

detail.quoteText: Innovation, sustainability and resilient infrastructure are shaping the next era of energy.
detail.conclusionText: The future of the oil and gas industry is bright, with immense opportunities driven by innovation, sustainability and rising global energy demand. Companies that adapt to changing market conditions and invest in advanced technologies will be well-positioned to achieve long-term success.

sections.title: Growing Demand for Energy
sections.description: Despite the global shift towards renewable energy, oil and gas remain essential for powering industries, transportation and households. Rising urbanization, industrialization and population growth continue to drive energy demand, creating new opportunities for exploration and production.
